references.phrase: free module R^(I) on index set I
references.context: Direct sum of copies of R indexed by I with finite support, I not assumed finite.
External direct sum decomposition of R-modules exhibiting P as a direct summand.

references.phrase: free module need not have finite rank
references.disposition: The characterization of arbitrary projectives allows infinite index set I, unlike finite projective modules.

review_rationale: Read the direct-summand criterion for projective modules as the existence of a complement Q to P inside a possibly infinite free R-module, distinguishing direct sum from quotient or finite freeness.
